generations.text: Yara Petrov contacted support because the Volt Charger charges at half speed since 2026-01-03. It is a Low priority case and the status is currently New. The customer was told a firmware update would arrive on 2026-01-29. The case was escalated to tier 2 on 2026-01-16. The knowledge base notes that Volt Charger stops at 80 percent for 2 hours on a hot day. The customer sounds frustrated and wants a quick resolution.

prompt:

Write a warm, fluent summary of this case in four to six sentences for the agent who picks it up next: who the customer is, what went wrong and since when, how urgent it is, what has been done so far, what the knowledge base says about this product, and how the customer seems to feel about it. Use only the case, its comments and the knowledge passages below.
